goal: Fix the intermittent timeout in the sync job (reports say it fails about one run in ten).

steps.instructions: Find the likely cause of the timeout from logs, code and history. Record the evidence and the ranked hypotheses. Do not change code.
Write a failing test or script that reproduces the top hypothesis. Commit it as a test only.
Fix the cause so the reproduction passes. Keep the change minimal.
Run the full test suite and the reproduction 50 times. Report pass counts and anything still flaky.
